propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Populum tuum, quaesumus, Domine, propitius respice: et, quos ab escis
carnalibus praecipis abstinere, a noxiis quoque vitiis cessare concede. Per
Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

refused.catholic-public-domain-version: Esth 13:8 has no exact selection recorded for this edition: this edition prints Esther in the Septuagint arrangement and in fifteen chapters, so no Vulgate chapter or verse number addresses the matter it names: its 1:1 is the Vulgate's 11:2, its 3:1 is the Vulgate's 1:1, and its 13:9 is part of the king's letter and not Mardochai's prayer
